answer: Each identity must post a 500-token bond and a unique hardware credential recorded once, and the bond is subject to slashing by independent jurors. Forging N identities locks 500N tokens for 12 epochs, with a 70% slash on proven duplication, and copied credentials are flagged at the inlet. Splitting yields new bonds inside the walnut band until the reported delta of unique devices forces marginal cost per fake identity above any yield.
